svg.text: flashstack — four layers, one measurement
agent/ + bench/
ReAct loop: strict-JSON actions over calculator, BM25 doc search, mock API. 20 frozen tasks.
Harness runs the identical suite against three backends and records each figure's provenance.
measurement workload
server/
FastAPI, OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions with SSE streaming.
Static batching: up to 4 requests grouped in a 25 ms window, then lockstep decode.
HTTP surface
engine/
Model runners (GPT-2, Qwen2.5-0.5B), preallocated fp16 KV cache, sampling.
RoPE and GQA head expansion in plain PyTorch; every non-attention op stays eager.
~1,388 GPU launches per decoded token — the number the benchmark turns out to measure.
no framework rewrite
flashattn_cuda — hand-written CUDA
prefill: one block per (batch, head, query tile), online softmax, causal tiles skipped not masked.
decode: split-K over cached keys, log-sum-exp merge, chunk size chosen per launch to fill the device.
fp16 in/out, fp32 accumulation, head_dim = 64 static. 90 GPU tests against fp32 SDPA at 2e-3.
separate repository
Attention is ~1.5% of decode wall clock. The other 98.5% is what the benchmark found.
